world.title: 旋转圆叠加出方波与周期曲线
world.posterTitle: 傅里叶级数把周期信号分解为正弦波
world.posterHook: 增减谐波项数，看圆链末端如何一步步描出方波；还可以随手画一条线，让它现场分解。
world.posterSource: Canvas 2D · 实时 DFT · 本地构建
world.question: 一串旋转的圆，为什么能画出任何曲线？
world.hook: 每个圆是一个正弦分量，首尾相接就能叠加出任意周期曲线。调项数、换波形、甚至手绘一条曲线看它现场分解。
world.payoff: 傅里叶级数：任何周期信号都能分解为整数倍频率的正弦波之和。项数越多越逼近，但跳变处约 9% 的吉布斯过冲永远不会消失。

en.title: Rotating circles combine into square waves and periodic curves
en.posterTitle: Fourier series decompose periodic signals into sine waves
en.posterHook: Increase or decrease the number of harmonic terms to see how the end of the circular chain draws a square wave step by step; you can also draw a line and have it decomposed on the spot.
en.question: Why can a series of rotating circles draw any curves?
en.hook: Each circle is a sinusoidal component, and any periodic curve can be superimposed end to end. Adjust the number of terms, change the waveform, and even draw a curve by hand to see it decompose on the spot.
en.payoff: Fourier series: Any periodic signal can be decomposed into the sum of sine waves with integer multiples of frequency. The approximation gets better with more terms, but the ~9% Gibbs overshoot at the jump never goes away.
